criteria.requirement: RepositoryEnv reads a file at construction; a new repository sees the new file while the old one retains its data. Config reads environment on each call. Reconstruct and deliberately publish a validated application configuration; do not invent automatic file watching or an atomic multi-key snapshot.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
